**Do not submit a public issue for a security vulnerability.** This template contains no vulnerability intake fields.

GitHub private vulnerability reporting is the preferred channel but was disabled at the 2026-10-30 audit. An active private security contact is a RELEASE BLOCKER. Check [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the current status; wait for an authorized private channel before sharing sensitive details. Do not paste a proof of concept, logs, tokens or personal data here.
